name: 3M Littmann Cardiology IV Stethoscope (6201)
metaDescription: The Littmann Cardiology IV in model 6201 makes a memorable gift for nurse practitioner grads, cardiac nurses, or any nurse ready for a stethoscope upgrade.
summary: A Littmann Cardiology IV in model 6201, a gift that marks a big step like finishing an NP program or moving into critical care.
whyItWorks: Finishing an NP program, passing boards, or landing a spot in the ICU all deserve more than a card. A stethoscope from the Cardiology IV line is a gift that nurses tend to associate with that next level, and it is something they will put to use on their very first shift in the new role. Because it rests around their neck all day, it becomes part of how they show up at work.

Model 6201 is one color and finish variation within the Cardiology IV family. The title does not spell out the colors, so look closely at the listing photos and compare it with the 6200 and other versions if they have a favorite shade. Partners and parents often worry about getting a clinical gift wrong, so it helps to quietly ask a coworker which brand and line the nurse already uses. Add a card that mentions the milestone, and consider a stethoscope ID tag so it does not get mixed up with someone else's at the station.
goodToKnow: Confirm the color and finish on the listing, since 6201 is a model number rather than a color name.
If the nurse already owns a Cardiology IV, a different gift may be better than a second one.
Keep the receipt handy in case they would prefer a different color.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nurse practitioner graduate?
faq.a: Yes. The Cardiology IV line is a popular choice for NPs starting their first role, which makes it a meaningful graduation gift.

faq.q: How do you pick between Cardiology IV models?
faq.a: They differ mainly in color and finish. Choose the one that best matches the nurse's style or the scrubs color they wear most.
